title: List script helpers
summary: List the axi* helpers that --with-helpers adds to a script (offline)
output: axiHex,"axiHex(hex, alpha?)",'#RGB' or '#RRGGBB' to an RGBA8; alpha 0-1 (default 1; a value 2-255 is taken as a byte)
axiDoc,"axiDoc(w, h, dpi?)",new pixel document (1 unit = 1 px at 72 dpi)
